description: React components and hooks providing accessibility enhancements, such as screen reader only text, skip links, live regions, focus management, and accessibility providers, used in a web application's UI.

methods.name: ScreenReaderOnly
methods.description: A component rendering visually hidden text accessible to screen readers.

methods.name: SkipLink
methods.description: A component rendering a skip link for keyboard navigation with focus styles.

methods.name: LiveRegion
methods.description: A component for announcing dynamic content updates via ARIA live regions.

methods.name: FocusTrap
methods.description: A component that traps focus within its children, useful for modals.

methods.name: KeyboardNavigable
methods.description: A helper component for handling keyboard navigation keys within a focusable element.

methods.name: StatusAnnouncer
methods.description: Announces status messages for screen readers with a delay.

methods.name: ProgressAnnouncer
methods.description: Announces progress updates for long operations.

methods.name: ErrorAnnouncer
methods.description: Announces error messages, with optional automatic clearing.

methods.name: MCPAccessibilityProvider
methods.description: Component providing skip links specific to MCP sections for accessibility.

methods.name: useAccessibility
methods.description: A hook providing functions to announce status, errors, and focus elements programmatically.
